_readme: Permanent regression corpus for comms-lint. Every rule miss found in a sweep or review gets appended here with provenance and NEVER removed — the suite only grows. Seed cases below are reconstructed representatives of real past incidents (marked in provenance); future entries should carry the verbatim offending text.

cases.name: per-visit wording on recurring pricing
cases.text: Your quarterly plan is $117 per visit, billed after each service.
cases.provenance: reconstructed — 2026-07-23 estimate-copy sweep (#2965/6/8): recurring is billed per application, never per visit

cases.name: commercial account exempt from per-application wording
cases.text: Service is $250 per visit under the commercial agreement.
cases.provenance: owner ruling: commercial accounts are exempt from the per-application phrasing rule

cases.name: emoji in customer text
cases.text: See you tomorrow at 10am! 🐜
cases.provenance: owner ruling 2026-08-10: zero emojis in customer messages, ever

cases.name: url shortener in sms
cases.text: Pay here: bit.ly/waves-pay
cases.provenance: A2P 10DLC registration is non-resubmittable; shorteners are an instant-loss class

cases.name: portal link must go bare in sms
cases.text: You can see your balance at https://portal.wavespestcontrol.com anytime.
cases.provenance: 2026-08-01 SMS link-scheme ruling: portal links drop https://, third-party links keep it

cases.name: bare g.page loses its scheme
cases.text: We would love a review: g.page/r/waves-review
cases.provenance: 2026-08-01 SMS link-scheme ruling — g.page KEEPS https://

cases.name: review link with scheme passes
cases.text: We would love a review: https://g.page/r/waves-review
cases.provenance: correct third-party link form

cases.name: re-entry described as safe
cases.text: Once the treatment dries it is completely safe for your pets and kids to go back on the lawn.
cases.provenance: reconstructed — site-compliance sweep class 2026-07-11: re-entry is never described as safe

cases.name: EPA-approved is banned wording
cases.text: All our products are EPA-approved and applied by licensed technicians.
cases.provenance: AGENTS.md compliance language: EPA-registered/EPA-exempt is the REQUIRED wording, EPA-approved is banned (seed originally encoded the inverted rule; corrected pre-merge per Codex pre-push review 2026-08-11)

cases.name: EPA-registered is the required wording
cases.text: All our products are EPA-registered and applied per the label.
cases.provenance: AGENTS.md compliance language: EPA-registered/EPA-exempt is the correct form

cases.name: sanctioned conditional idiom passes
cases.text: The lawn is safe once it's fully dry, and the tech will confirm timing before leaving.
cases.provenance: AGENTS.md approved idiom: "safe once dry" WITH the technician confirming timing — both parts required

cases.name: fixed drying figure is banned
cases.text: Keep pets off the treated lawn for 30 minutes while it dries.
cases.provenance: AGENTS.md compliance language: never a fixed re-entry/drying figure — the tech confirms timing on site (seed replaced pre-merge per Codex pre-push review 2026-08-11: the original neutral-instruction case carried "about an hour to dry", itself a violation)

cases.name: curly apostrophe flips encoding
cases.text: We’ll see you tomorrow between 10 and noon, and the tech will text when heading your way.
cases.provenance: house-voice punctuation rule: one typographic character silently doubles segment count (UCS-2)

cases.name: three-segment message over the limit
cases.text: Hello! Here is everything about your new plan. Your Healthy Home Starter includes an initial deep treatment inside and out, then recurring exterior applications every other month with free re-services between visits if anything shows up. You pay per application, never per month, and you can pause or cancel anytime. The initial visit runs about 45 minutes and covers baseboards, entry points, garage, eaves, and the yard perimeter. Reply here with any questions about scheduling.
cases.provenance: reconstructed — the plans-invite template was the only 3-segment template in prod (fixed in #3343)

cases.name: stop line on transactional message
cases.text: Your appointment is confirmed for Tuesday 10am. Reply STOP to opt out.
cases.provenance: #3343 owner directive 2026-08-10: transactional SMS to known customers carries no STOP tail

cases.name: missing stop line on first-touch
cases.text: Hi, this is Waves Pest Control returning your call about a quote.
cases.provenance: #3343 keep-list: first-touch/compliance classes keep their opt-out line (CTIA)

cases.name: boilerplate closer
cases.text: Your service is scheduled for Friday. Questions or requests? Reply to this message.
cases.provenance: house-voice v9 change: dropped the mandatory closer boilerplate; the message just ends

cases.name: wrong company name
cases.text: Thanks from all of us at Waves Lawn & Pest.
cases.provenance: standing rule: the company is "Waves Pest Control", never "Waves Lawn & Pest"

cases.name: typical clean confirmation
cases.text: Hello Sarah! You're confirmed for Tuesday between 10am and noon. Marcus will text when he's on the way.
cases.provenance: the target form: greeting, answer, done — one exclamation, one segment, no tail

cases.name: two-segment disclosure message passes
cases.text: Hello Dan! Your termite inspection is set for Thursday 8-10am. Please clear access to the garage walls and water heater closet, secure pets, and plan for the tech to be on site about an hour. The written report follows the same day by email with photos of anything we find.
cases.provenance: owner ruling 2026-08-01: 2 segments is fine — prep/disclosure content earns the length
